# `smelt.transcript.groups`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Everywhere, including headless mode.

Declarative transcript display grouping. Register adjacent-run group rules while the host owns deterministic planning and the composed root renderer presents resulting group nodes.

## `smelt.transcript.groups.generation`

```lua
fun(): integer
```

Current group-registry generation. Each registration or removal bumps it, and
grouped plans and layouts rebuild when it changes.

## `smelt.transcript.groups.list`

```lua
fun(): smelt.transcript.GroupSpec[]
```

Types: [`smelt.transcript.GroupSpec`](types.md#smelttranscriptgroupspec)

Return group specs in planner order: higher priority first, then registration order.

## `smelt.transcript.groups.register`

```lua
fun(spec: smelt.transcript.GroupSpec): smelt.Reg
```

Types: [`smelt.transcript.GroupSpec`](types.md#smelttranscriptgroupspec), [`smelt.Reg`](types.md#smeltreg)

Register or replace a declarative transcript group type. This only declares
planning metadata; Rust owns deterministic adjacent-run planning and the
composed root transcript renderer presents resulting group nodes.
